scope: Genuine pre-edit current compiler run using wholly synthetic in-memory Storage. No production/private/provider data or native invocation.

freshness.basis: Existing engine schedule plus explicit allowance; every measurement retains its own upstream deadline.

quality.basis: Retained upstream output identity and dated typed context; not strategy validation.

crisis.ciss_context: CISS remains available in the linked upstream research; it is not an extra score here.

funding.interpretation: Overlapping canonical macro, credit and volatility observations; zero independent investment votes. WAIT is abstention.

fails.note: Cumulative two-sided gross reported fails. These scopes overlap; never add them. Not defaults, losses, unique securities or capital flows.

dependency_graph.note: Series identity is not statistical independence. Different dates are retained separately; conflicting same-date values receive no automatic winner.

decision.meaning: Abstain from a new recommendation; not a target position or an instruction to hold existing risk.
decision.reason: No independently validated top/bottom forecasting or allocation policy is registered.

packet.headline: Dated research context; no qualified market-turn signal.
packet.interpretation: Overlapping observations and source gaps remain visible; missing evidence is never neutral or zero.

pd_settlement_fails.note: Cumulative two-sided gross reported fails. These scopes overlap; never add them. Not defaults, losses, unique securities or capital flows.

portfolio_consequences.method: Entered signed exposure multiplied by an explicit price shock
limitations: No engine-inferred return or shock probability.
No FX, dividends, financing, fees, convexity or hedge response.
Position-specific risk requires separately entered or verified holdings.

packet.replay_scope: Exact synthesis from retained upstream publication bytes and retained upstream run/output identities. Upstream provider originals are not re-parsed by this compiler.
